products.description:
Shared iPhones your frontline can share safely

A pool of shift iPhones with one shared account — or a kiosk lockdown — leaves the previous worker's mail, chats, and tokens on the device for the next person. Lockdown limits which app runs; it does not give anyone a private session. This solution configures Microsoft Entra ID Shared Device Mode (SDM) on shared iPhones via Intune so each worker gets a real per-user identity session: global sign-in (sign in once, all supporting apps know you) and single sign-out (sign out once, your identity and app data are cleared for the next person) — across Microsoft Teams and MSAL line-of-business apps.

The Microsoft-native answer for shared iPhones. Apple's Shared iPad runs only on iPad hardware — it can't help an iPhone fleet. Entra Shared Device Mode is how you give pooled iPhones a genuine sign-in/sign-out experience.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every group, profile, and app you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) whose acceptance gate is the two-user clean hand-off: user A signs out, user B signs in with no trace of A.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Entra Shared Device Mode works on iPhones (no-affinity enrollment, Authenticator shared-mode registration, SDM-aware apps), global sign-in / single sign-out, what it isolates honestly, and why iPhones need it (Apple Shared iPad is iPad-only).
  • Requirements Guide — every ABM/ADE, Entra, Intune, role, and app prerequisite with how to verify/implement each — including the Assigned-group + Intune Provisioning Client owner detail that makes enrollment-time grouping actually work.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to build the named foundation (assigned group + owner, no-affinity ADE profile, apps, restrictions, Cloud Device Administrator), register a device into shared mode, then pilot and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — readiness discovery, foundation validation, a shared-pool inventory, safe remediation (creates the Assigned group and sets the Provisioning Client owner), and an app target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (two-user clean hand-off, empty-group, affinity, shared-mode registration, sign-out data-clearing) plus Best Practices treating app scope as the security boundary.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next site and the next shift.

The bottom line

Pooled iPhones your frontline can share safely — each worker signed in as themselves, each sign-out a clean hand-off — deployed and proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • IOSSDMFL-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for iPhone Shared Device Mode
    • IOSSDMFL-Remediation.ps1 — safely create the Assigned group and set the Intune Provisioning Client owner
    • IOSSDMFL-Report.ps1 — shared-pool inventory of no-affinity iOS iPhones
    • IOSSDMFL-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — assign a shared-device app to the shared-iPhone group
    • IOSSDMFL-Validation.ps1 — validate group ownership, ADE affinity, and app assignments

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
